compiled_state.title: [.test-index]: comma-separated test names in single [...] marker -> pytest -k expression syntax error
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** $(git rev-parse HEAD)
* **CI workflow:** .github/workflows/ci-python-skills.yml
* **Test runner:** tests/skills/run-python-tests.sh

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Each RED-phase test in .test-index is marked by its own `[test_name]` bracket pair. The bash regex in tests/skills/run-python-tests.sh extracts each bracketed marker as a single entry and joins them with " or " into the pytest -k exclusion expression.

#### Actual Behavior

Line 197 of .test-index contains a single bracket pair enclosing three comma-separated test names:

```
plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/arbiter.py:tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py [test_dispatch_arbiter_called_on_resustain_of_with_prior_defense],tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py [test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_block_when_critical_finding_undefended,test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_defer_when_cycle_exceeds_max,test_validate_cycle_end_ruling_raises_on_unknown_ruling],tests/scripts/test-cycle-arbiter.sh
```

The regex captures `test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_block_when_critical_finding_undefended,test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_defer_when_cycle_exceeds_max,test_validate_cycle_end_ruling_raises_on_unknown_ruling` as a single marker (commas treated as part of the marker name). When joined with " or " into the -k expression, the result is `not (... or test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_block_when_critical_finding_undefended,test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_defer_when_cycle_exceeds_max,test_validate_cycle_end_ruling_raises_on_unknown_ruling or ...)` which is invalid pytest syntax.

CI failure URL: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/26011074480/job/76451637837

Error: `ERROR: Wrong expression passed to '-k': not (... or test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_block_when_critical_finding_undefended,test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_defer_when_cycle_exceeds_max,test_validate_cycle_end_ruling_raises_on_unknown_ruling or ...): at column 241: expected right parenthesis; got ,`

Failure cascade: CI Python Skills fails on every commit on main since the malformed line was added, and on every PR. Blocks PR #213 (follow-up to PR #212 §A+§B reviewer-prompt fixes).

### 3. Action History

The malformed entry was introduced as part of the swap-maple-flyby (arbiter rewrite) epic — commit 803172b9f8 ("test(arbiter): canonical fixture corpus for BLOCK/DEFER/DROP cycle-end rulings") or adjacent commits in PR #206-#208. The author likely intended `[name1] [name2] [name3]` (three separate brackets) but wrote `[name1,name2,name3]` (one bracket).

### 4. Proposed Fix

Split the multi-name bracket on line 197 of .test-index into three separate bracket pairs. The regex iterates over each `[...]` after the .py path, so three brackets on one entry work; or split into three separate test-arbiter.py entries on the same line.

Current (line 197):
```
... tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py [test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_block_when_critical_finding_undefended,test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_defer_when_cycle_exceeds_max,test_validate_cycle_end_ruling_raises_on_unknown_ruling] ...
```

Fixed:
```
... tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py [test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_block_when_critical_finding_undefended] [test_dispatch_arbiter_returns_defer_when_cycle_exceeds_max] [test_validate_cycle_end_ruling_raises_on_unknown_ruling] ...
```

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* Affected: .test-index (data file, root)
* Reader: tests/skills/run-python-tests.sh (bash regex)
* Triggered by: .github/workflows/ci-python-skills.yml job "Python Skill/Doc Tests"

### 6. Logs

Reproducer:
```
bash tests/skills/run-python-tests.sh
```

Expected exit 0; actual exit 4 with the malformed -k error.
